# Bellwether

Bellwether tracks confirmed SaaS pricing changes and publishes the underlying dataset as static, structured files, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

## Endpoints
- https://bellwether-nicholas-projects-cdfeb046.vercel.app/data/board.json — current pricing snapshot per competitor
- https://bellwether-nicholas-projects-cdfeb046.vercel.app/data/changes.json — confirmed change log with annotations
- https://bellwether-nicholas-projects-cdfeb046.vercel.app/data/timeline.json — per-competitor price history series
- https://bellwether-nicholas-projects-cdfeb046.vercel.app/data/dataset.json — the full dataset, nested
- https://bellwether-nicholas-projects-cdfeb046.vercel.app/data/dataset.csv — the full dataset, flat
- https://bellwether-nicholas-projects-cdfeb046.vercel.app/changes.xml — RSS feed of confirmed changes
